args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE transparent square animation key-pose sheet, exactly TWO columns by TWO rows, four equal cells with generous transparent gutters. No labels, grid, background, shadows or text.
Input1 is original anatomy/design authority; input2 original face and color authority, not a request to repeat its happy smile. Draw the SAME recognizable Victamin in every cell: a limbless cheerleader paper-pompom bunny, exactly TWO complete long oval cream ears, orange inner ear on viewer-left and yellow on viewer-right; broad overlapping cream-white rectangular paper tabs with soft butter-yellow and apricot accents; two orange square cheeks, tiny dark-brown eyes. No arms, hands, legs, feet, fur, clothes or hat. Warm clean matte cel illustration, crisp taupe outlines, sparse broad seams, simple readable features. Entire ears and body inside each cell, consistent body width and ground baseline at88% of the cell. Genuine transparent alpha.
These four frames are a recovery sequence after dizziness, NOT a happy dance. Keep body upright on the same ground; the head and ears make small brisk left/right motions without changing anatomy. Both eyes follow the same expression and stay level on the face. Mouth always small, dark, closed and never smiling.
Reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom:
1. Dazed and bracing: softly squeezed strained eyes, small horizontal wavy tilde mouth (~), upright body, ears slightly unsteady. No grin, upturned mouth or happy eye-smile.
2. Brisk head shake toward viewer-left: same strained eyes and wavy closed mouth; ears flex with the turn, body stays grounded. Clear continuous paper layers, no blur or duplicate outlines.
3. Brisk head shake toward viewer-right: opposite small motion, same uncomfortable strained eyes and small wavy mouth, both ears remain intact. Neither joyful nor crying.
4. Recovered: centered upright ears, small round alert dark eyes and a short neutral horizontal closed mouth. Calm focused attention, no grin, no open mouth, no relief-smile.
Four coherent hand-drawn temporal keys of one mascot. No external symbols, glow, motion trails, fuzzy detail, dithering or lettering. Preserve the characteristic rectangular pompom silhouette and source identity.
